newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SHILTON SET TO MOVE AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHILTON SET TO MOVE AGAIN.

text.p: Former England goalkeeper Peter Shilton is set to make the short move across East London from West Ham to join third division Leyton Orient.
The 47-year-old, who won a record 125 England caps, will make Orient his 12th club when Les Sealey makes the opposite journey to Upton Park.
Tommy Taylor, the new Orient manager, said on Wednesday: "Once the Sealey move back to Upton Park is confirmed, we can then complete the signing of Shilton."
Shilton, whose last league game was for Bolton in May last year, is only four short of 1,000 league appearances in his career.
